import struct, subprocess
BASE=0x400000; msg=b"OK-ARM64\n"
def movz(xd,i): return 0xD2800000|((i&0xffff)<<5)|(xd&31)
def build(code_off=0x78, e_type=2, base=BASE, extra=None, align=0x1000, flags=5):
    code=[movz(0,1),None,movz(2,len(msg)),movz(8,64),0xD4000001,movz(0,0),movz(8,93),0xD4000001]
    msg_off=code_off+4*len(code)
    imm=((base+msg_off)-(base+code_off+4))//4
    code[1]=0x58000000|((imm&0x7ffff)<<5)|1
    blob=b"".join(struct.pack("<I",x) for x in code)
    ident=b"\x7fELF"+bytes([2,1,1,0])+b"\x00"*8
    total=msg_off+len(msg)
    ph=[struct.pack("<IIQQQQQQ",1,flags,0,base,base,total,total,align)]
    if extra: ph.append(extra)
    eh=ident+struct.pack("<HHIQQQIHHHHHH",e_type,183,1,base+code_off,64,0,0,64,56,len(ph),0,0,0)
    o=bytearray(eh+b"".join(ph)); o+=b"\x00"*(code_off-len(o)); o+=blob; o+=msg
    return bytes(o)
V={
 "exec_RX": build(),
 "exec_RWX": build(flags=7),
 "dyn_base0": build(base=0,e_type=3),
 "gnustack": build(extra=struct.pack("<IIQQQQQQ",0x6474e551,6,0,0,0,0,0,0x10)),
 "align64k": build(align=0x10000),
 "align_no": build(align=0),
}
for k,v in V.items():
    p="/tmp/%s.elf"%k; open(p,"wb").write(v)
    r=subprocess.run(["qemu-aarch64",p],capture_output=True)
    o=(r.stdout+r.stderr).decode("utf-8","replace").strip().replace("\n"," | ")
    print("%-12s rc=%-3s %s" % (k, r.returncode, o[:110]))
print("=== lld ===")
print(subprocess.run(["bash","-lc","ls /usr/lib/llvm-18/bin 2>/dev/null | grep -i lld; command -v ld.lld lld; dpkg -l 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'lld|clang' | awk '{print $2,$3}'"],capture_output=True).stdout.decode())
